- Date column had 3 invalid dates (2026-14-01, 13/45/2026, 2026-02-30) set to missing.

Analysis result (sum of Quantity per Region, using all 43 rows):

- North: 40 units
- South: 53 units
- West: 62 units

Caveat: 3 rows have missing Date values after parsing; Quantity sums are unaffected.
